headword: {利害|りがい}{調整|ちょうせい}
gloss: coordination of interests; balancing of interests

definitions.gloss: coordination of interests; balancing of competing interests; interest mediation
definitions.explanation: The process of mediating between parties with different or conflicting interests to reach a workable compromise. A core concept in Japanese politics, business negotiations, and organizational management.

examples.japanese: ⟦{関係者|かんけいしゃ}→関係者：16441_kankeisha⟧⟦{間|かん}→〜間：28469_kan⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{利害|りがい}{調整|ちょうせい}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{難|むずか}しい→難しい：00517_muzukashii⟧。
examples.english: Coordinating interests among the parties involved is difficult.

examples.japanese: ⟦{政策|せいさく}→政策：10070_seisaku⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{決|き}める→決める：00858_kimeru⟧⟦{前|まえ}→前：02255_mae⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧、{各省庁|かくしょうちょう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{利害|りがい}{調整|ちょうせい}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{必要|ひつよう}→必要：00846_hitsuyou⟧だ。
examples.english: Before deciding on policy, coordination of interests among the ministries is necessary.

examples.japanese: ⟦{地域|ちいき}→地域：01461_chiiki⟧⟦{住民|じゅうみん}→住民：03281_juumin⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{開発|かいはつ}→開発：06746_kaihatsu⟧⟦{業者|ぎょうしゃ}→業者：13130_gyousha⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{利害|りがい}{調整|ちょうせい}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{時間|じかん}→時間：00468_jikan⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦かかり→かかる：00711_kakaru⟧、⟦{計画|けいかく}→計画：01172_keikaku⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{遅|おく}れている→遅れる：00741_okureru⟧。
examples.english: The plan is delayed because coordinating the interests of local residents and the developer is taking time.

notes:
A compound of ⟦{利害|りがい}→利害：04091_rigai⟧ (interests, gains and losses) and ⟦{調整|ちょうせい}→調整：14839_chousei⟧ (adjustment, coordination). This concept is central to Japanese consensus-building (⟦{根回|ねまわ}し→根回し：07727_nemawashi⟧) culture, where decisions are often preceded by extensive behind-the-scenes negotiation to align all parties before a formal announcement.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {利害|りがい}{調整|ちょうせい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{行|おこな}う→行う：01238_okonau⟧: to carry out interest coordination
- {利害|りがい}{調整|ちょうせい}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{難航|なんこう}する→難航する：19360_nankousuru⟧: interest coordination hits difficulties
- {利害|りがい}{調整|ちょうせい}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{役割|やくわり}→役割：03638_yakuwari⟧: the role of mediating interests
- {利害|りがい}{調整|ちょうせい}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{時間|じかん}がかかる→時間がかかる：26082_jikangakakaru⟧: interest coordination takes time

USAGE:
Common in political reporting, especially regarding legislation that affects multiple stakeholders. Also appears in business contexts when departments or companies have conflicting objectives.

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{根回|ねまわ}し→根回し：07727_nemawashi⟧: prior consultation, groundwork — informal consensus-building before a decision
- ⟦{利害関係|りがいかんけい}→利害関係：19524_rigaikankei⟧: conflict of interest; interest relationship — the state of having competing interests
- ⟦{調停|ちょうてい}→調停：14251_choutei⟧: mediation, arbitration — a more formal legal process for dispute resolution
